websocket_port.description: Port on which the WebSocket listener will accept connections (typically 1883 for unencrypted, or 8883 for encrypted).

websocket_bind_address.description: IP address the WebSocket listener binds to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only, '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces).

max_websocket_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent WebSocket connections allowed.

websocket_keepalive.description: Interval (in seconds) for WebSocket ping/pong keep-alive messages to detect broken connections.

websocket_idle_timeout.description: Time (in seconds) after which an idle WebSocket connection is closed.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for secure WebSocket (wss://) connections. Required if connecting over HTTPS or from browsers requiring encrypted connections.

tls_version.description: Minimum TLS version to accept (e.g., 'tlsv1.2', 'tlsv1.3'). Only used if TLS is enabled.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server's TLS certificate file. Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_key_file.description: Path to the server's TLS private key file. Required if TLS is enabled.

tls_ca_file.description: Path to a CA certificate bundle for validating client certificates (optional, for mutual TLS). Leave empty to disable client cert verification.

require_auth.description: If true, require username/password authentication for all WebSocket clients. Overrides `allow_anonymous`.

password_file.description: Path to the Mosquitto password file (used only if `require_auth` is true).

allow_anonymous.description: If true (and `require_auth` is false), allow unauthenticated WebSocket connections. Not recommended for public-facing servers.

log_file.description: Path to the log file for WebSocket-related messages.

persistence_dir.description: Directory where Mosquitto stores its persistence data (e.g., retained messages, subscriptions).
